items.criterion: A submitted solution is executed outside the request that accepted it and its verdict is attached to the stored submission afterwards.
items.judgment: Submit a sleeping solution and read the intake response, then read the submission back until it settles.

items.criterion: A solution that never terminates settles as Time Limit Exceeded within the judging deadline.
items.judgment: Submit a non-terminating solution and read the settled verdict.

items.criterion: A loop ignoring every catchable signal is still stopped as Time Limit Exceeded.
items.judgment: Submit a signal-ignoring loop and read the settled verdict.

items.criterion: A solution that exits cleanly having produced nothing settles as Wrong Answer.
items.judgment: Submit a solution returning nothing and read the settled verdict.

items.criterion: Four simultaneous accepted submissions move both counters by exactly four.
items.judgment: Submit four accepted solutions concurrently and read the counters.

items.criterion: Walking every cursor page of the catalogue yields each seeded problem exactly once.
items.judgment: Page the catalogue to the end in three orders.

items.criterion: A facet count reports what the list would return if that value were added to the current filter set.
items.judgment: Read the facets with a difficulty selected and compare against adding each value.

items.criterion: An isolated program reaches no network, database or app surface.
items.judgment: Submit a guarded solution that attempts connections and read the verdict.

items.criterion: A gated statement read without an entitlement is refused as payment-required.
items.judgment: Read a premium problem as a member with no entitlement.

items.criterion: Another member's submission answers as if the record does not exist.
items.judgment: Create a submission as one member and read it as another.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous draft writes leave one stored row holding one of the two bodies.
items.judgment: Write two drafts together and read the stored row.

items.criterion: An earlier compile error adds 300 seconds of penalty and later or unsolved wrong submissions add nothing.
items.judgment: Compete with two probes in the running contest and read the standings.

items.criterion: Every price is held as an integer of the currency's minor unit with its currency code.
items.judgment: Read the seeded price list and inspect the amount types.

items.criterion: A solve after a gap resets the streak to one while keeping the longest run.
items.judgment: Set the last qualifying day back and solve again.

items.criterion: Every public route carries its own document title and its own description.
items.judgment: Read each public route and compare the titles and descriptions.

items.criterion: The workspace reads as one instrument in which the statement and the editor are used together.
items.judgment: Open a problem and use the two panes as a solver would.

items.criterion: The catalogue reads as a dense working list rather than a marketing page.
items.judgment: Open the catalogue and look at the density and the hierarchy.
